summary: Updated implementation plan built on the current Vault City game state: (1) Forgiving Days 1-10 Early-Game Grace & Rebalanced Resource/Dweller Upkeep with Eco-Conservation Mode to escape Resource Deficits, (2) Deeper 10-Day Boss Siege Combat with 3 Tactical Countermeasures (EMP Pulse, Flak Volley, Emergency Door Seal), (3) 2 New Deep-Core B5 Vault Rooms (#9 Geothermal Tap & #10 Cryo-Stasis Vault) + Room Specialization Modes, (4) Expanded Wasteland Expeditions & Apex Boss Hunts, and (5) Enhanced 2D Vault B5 Cutaway Visuals, CRT Radar Sweep Animations & Haptic Alerts.
